messages.content: You are a precise information extraction system. You only output valid JSON.

Extract entities and events from the document below.

Entity types: Person, Organization, Location, Building, Product, Art, Other

Event types and their argument roles:
- Attack: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Consequence
- Military_operation: roles = Agent, Patient, Location
- Conquering: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Name
- Killing: roles = Killer, Victim, Location, Cause, Instrument
- Death: roles = Agent, Cause, Location, Instrument
- Bodily_harm: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Cause
- Catastrophe: roles = Patient, Location, Loss, Content
- Destroying: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Loss
- Damaging: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Loss
- Statement: roles = Speaker, Message, Location, Details
- Change_of_leadership: roles = New_leader, Old_leader, Location, Selector, New_Occupation, Old_Occupation
- Arriving: roles = Agent, Location

Rules:
1. Copy every entity mention, trigger and argument exactly as it appears in the document.
2. List every entity mention (including repeated mentions of the same entity).
3. Create one event entry for every trigger occurrence of the event types above. Ignore other kinds of events.
4. Arguments may appear anywhere in the document, not only in the trigger's sentence. Omit roles with no argument.

Return a JSON object in exactly this format:
{
  "entities": [
    {
      "text": "<entity mention copied from the text>",
      "type": "<entity type>"
    }
  ],
  "events": [
    {
      "trigger": "<word or short phrase in the text that signals the event>",
      "type": "<event type>",
      "arguments": {
        "<role>": [
          "<argument span copied from the text>"
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}

Document:
The 2004 Iranian seizure of Royal Navy personnel took place in the Shatt al-Arab ( Arvand Rud in Persian ) waterway on 21 June . Six Royal Marines and two Royal Navy sailors were captured . The British servicemen were seized while training Iraqi river patrol personnel after Iran said they had strayed to the Iranian side of the waterway . They were threatened with legal action initially but released three days later following diplomatic discussions between Jack Straw , then British Foreign Secretary , and Kamal Kharazi , then Iranian Minister of Foreign Affairs . The weapons and boats of the British personnel were confiscated and have not been returned . They were released unharmed three days later , on 24 June , after the British and Iranian governments agreed there had been a misunderstanding . Their equipment was not returned and a rigid inflatable boat ( RIB ) was put on display in a museum in Tehran . During their detention , according to former detainee Marine Scott Fallon , they endured a mock execution in which they were marched into the desert and made to stand blindfolded in front of a ditch while their captors cocked their weapons . They also appeared blindfolded on Iranian TV , where they were forced to apologise for their `` mistake '' . The Royal Navy boats were operating close to the northern coast of the Persian Gulf in the mouth of the Shatt al-Arab waterway which divides southern Iran and Iraq . The weather was bad causing negligible visibility which may have contributed to a potential crossing of the Iranian border by the Royal Navy . After the crew were returned and events analysed the British government affirmed its belief that the personnel were actually still in Iraqi waters , however they consigned the incident to a misunderstanding and requested the return of the equipment . In 2015 , an FOIA request released a redacted report .
